capabilities: Pick the correct reading for each word
Style tones with marks, numbers, or colors
Hide pinyin until hover or tap for practice
extras: Works on desktop and iPhone/iPad; no network, telemetry, accounts, or payments. Not yet listed in Community plugins (manual install for now). Chinese only; no Cantonese Jyutping. Corrections are stored in the plugin's data.json.
intentEvidence: Tahoe Pinyin needs no code blocks: it works on the Chinese anywhere in your notes, while you edit too.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to show pinyin over Chinese text, and existing plugins require code blocks or special markers that clutter your notes.
